notes: The ground this area owns: the university's Lot 60 complex north of The Village, at 147 Clove Road (Little Falls), between the NJ Transit Great Notch Yard and the pond west of Lot 61. Inside: Lot 60 (OSM 233913162, about 12,150 m2), the bus lot south-west of it with its fan of angled aisles (OSM 840849374..381, unnamed), Lot 60N (OSM 287527901, about 3,450 m2), the open lot west of Lot 61 and south of the Vehicle Maintenance building (unnamed in OSM; the Village calls it 'the big lot north-west of Lot 61'), the drives and aisles between them (OSM 233913165, 233913138, 233913140, 233913256, 233913120, 1105425302), and three university buildings: University Facilities (the Facilities Building, OSM 785130901, long red roof), the Center for Clinical Services (OSM 233913261) and MSU Vehicle Maintenance (OSM 233913117, spelt 'Maintainence' in OSM). Names: Lot 60, Lot 60N, University Facilities and the Center for Clinical Services are the university's own (montclair.edu Facilities Services and Center for Clinical Services pages: both at 147 Clove Road, Lot 60); the folder name lot60 fits. A university page also names a Lot 63 near the clinic: which lot that is is not shown by any source here, so no lot is called Lot 63 (UNVERIFIED). Small sheds and tanks north of the Facilities Building (about (-150..-120, 1500..1530)) show in the LiDAR and the ortho but not in OSM. Edges. South: the Village footprint exactly, vertex for vertex: (-212, 1281), (-154, 1305) down Lot 61's west curb to (-160, 1356), north-east to (-138, 1378) and east along y 1378 to (-46, 1378). The Village's own items run up to 0.8 m past that line (Clove Road's north spur and the road to Lot 60N cut square at y 1378.5, Lot 61's asphalt to y 1378.8) and its north solar canopy (V_lot_61_canopy_N) reaches (-111, 1381.3): paving here starts at y 1378.3 and runs under the canopy's corner. East and north: the NJ Transit retaining wall, the university's boundary in OSM (233913199, 1169081706). The campus side is at 98.5 to 98.8 m, the yard behind the wall at 100.7 to 102.6 m; the footprint runs on the wall line, fitted through the gap in the LiDAR ground where the wall stands (runs: 71.1 deg through (-43.1, 1411.4), rms 0.19 m; 136.7 deg through (-61.6, 1461.3), rms 0.43 m; 134.2 deg through (-108.6, 1516.7), rms 0.60 m; 136.2 deg through (-152.7, 1548.4), rms 0.42 m; 155.3 deg through (-197.3, 1582.0), rms 0.33 m; 161.3 deg through (-230.1, 1586.4), rms 0.16 m), so the engine's step face up to the yard's skirt stands where the wall is. From (-46, 1378) the edge runs up to the wall's south end at (-51.1, 1388): the NJ Transit service road (OSM 840849382, private) between the wall and the Great Notch Substation fence (OSM 1168865774) is left out. The Great Notch Yard House (OSM 274639156, NJ Transit; its south-west wall is the university boundary) is left out with the footprint 1 m outside its south-west and north-west walls. West: 1 to 3 m outside the foot of the rock cut and hill that rise 5 to 18 m west of the drive and Lot 60 (the toe found where the LiDAR ground rises 1 m above the paving: x -300 at y 1448..1496, (-288, 1514), (-266, 1536), (-255, 1560)), so the coarse skirt's hill meets this ground at the toe as a bank and not as a hole; round the bus lot's west and north end 3 to 7 m outside its toe. South-west, and along the pond west of Lot 61 (OSM 233913170, not university ground) 4 to 8 m inland of its OSM shore, so the bank down to the water is inside. North-west corner at (-243, 1590.8), where the wall meets the hill; the white building at (-250, 1595) by the wall is left out. Left out: the yard, its tracks, the Yard House, the substation, the Montclair Line, Route 46, the pond and the houses on High Point Drive. Published ground inside today: only the 4 km context skirt (53,200 m2) and far-field house blocks for the three buildings. Village tree points (sw_t_-1_8, about 250 m2 of crowns) stand inside near the south edge (x -200..-155, y 1300..1330); they belong to v_trees.json. Evidence: /workspace/data/lot60 (ortho2020 0.15 m, x -420..0, y 1250..1600; LiDAR 2017 0.5 m, x -460..40, y 1210..1640; OSM; tiles dumps). Positions of things inside are from OSM, UNVERIFIED to the metre, until the zones fit them to the ortho and LiDAR.
